title: The Yoga of Practice
devanagari: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।
translation: If you cannot keep your mind steady on me, then seek to reach me through the yoga of practice, O Dhananjaya.
translation_hi: यदि तुम मन को मुझमें स्थिर नहीं रख सकते, तो हे धनंजय, अभ्यास योग के द्वारा मुझे पाने की इच्छा करो।
science: Practice changes the brain: repeating a skill strengthens the neural connections behind it (neuroplasticity). The Gita's 'yoga of practice' matches how learning works.
